title: Hotspots & stale objects
description: Where maintenance pays off: objects changed often and used widely (hotspots), and objects nobody references any more, by how long they have been left untouched (stale objects).
author: fm-lab core

params.name: type
params.description: Object types, comma-separated (default: all nine types with a usage meaning).

params.name: q
params.description: Search term over object name, type and file.

params.name: years
params.description: Age threshold of a cold object in years: 1, 2 (default) or 5.

params.name: quadrant
params.description: Quadrant of the ranking: hotspot (default), churn (changed often) or core (used widely).

params.name: state
params.description: State of the stale list: cold (default), unknown (age unknown), active or menu.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the list (1-based, 100 rows per page).
